title: Delicate Japanese Pilaf
description: A light and flavorful Japanese-inspired pilaf dish made with basmati rice, polish sausage, and a hint of butter.

ingredients.name: polish sausage
ingredients.notes: Slice the sausage thinly before cooking

instructions: Heat butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add polish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add basmati rice and stir to combine with sausage and onion.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
